<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 121.0528, which corresponds to the protonated ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈120.0455 Da. The formula C₄H₈O₄ has a calculated neutral mass of 120.0423 Da, giving a protonated m/z of 121.0495 Da, matching the observed value within experimental error. Therefore the molecular formula is C₄H₈O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
